name: NymVPN
author: Pepijn Blom
description: NymVPN status, connect/disconnect, entry and exit country switching, split-tunnel process bypass, and fair-use data usage in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Toggle NymVPN, switch entry and exit countries, bypass apps, and watch fair-use data.

schema.label: Enable IPv6
schema.description: Route IPv6 traffic through the tunnel. Keep disabled if your local network lacks global IPv6 routing.

schema.label: Fast mode (2-hop WireGuard)
schema.description: Use 2-hop WireGuard tunnel for speed; disable for 5-hop anonymous mixnet.

schema.label: Block ads and trackers
schema.description: Enable DNS-level ad and malicious domain blocking inside the tunnel.

schema.label: Bypass local network (LAN)
schema.description: Allow direct communication with devices on your local network (e.g. printers, NAS).

schema.label: Gateway independence
schema.description: Enforce separate node families, ASNs, and subnets for entry and exit nodes.

schema.label: Anti-censorship (Circumvention)
schema.description: Wrap entry gateway traffic to bypass restrictive firewalls and censorship.

schema.label: Prefer residential exit nodes
schema.description: Route exit traffic through residential IP addresses to avoid datacenter blocks.

schema.label: Use custom DNS
schema.description: Use custom DNS resolvers instead of Nym's default resolvers.

schema.label: Preferred entry country code
schema.description: Two-letter ISO country code for tunnel entry (e.g. NL). Leave empty for closest.

schema.label: Preferred exit country code
schema.description: Two-letter ISO country code for tunnel exit (e.g. DE). Leave empty for automatic.

schema.label: Auto-connect on desktop login
schema.description: Automatically connect the VPN tunnel when the desktop shell starts.

schema.label: Connection profile
schema.description: Connection template balancing privacy and speed (fastest, safest, most-private, random).

schema.label: Geo-exclusion proxy bypass
schema.description: Bypass the VPN tunnel for traffic destined for specific countries using a local transparent proxy.

schema.label: Geo-exclusion countries
schema.description: Space-separated ISO country codes to bypass (e.g. CN RU).

schema.label: Crash reporting (Sentry)
schema.description: Send crash reports to Nym to help fix bugs. Disable for complete telemetric silence.

schema.label: Anonymous network stats
schema.description: Share anonymous network health and routing statistics to help maintain the decentralized Nym network.
